meta.method: Colors, font sizes and geometry read from the PDF drawing and text layers (PyMuPDF); 1pt = 1.3333px.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Print is always white; the dark value is a derived screen theme with no counterpart in the source.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Ground behind a page when several pages are shown on screen. Added for screen use; the source has none.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, table cells, captions and Fuente notes on `paper`. 21:1 on print white; 14.6:1 on the dark paper.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Controlled-document header text (INFORME TÉCNICO, Fecha, Versión, Hoja) and the cover title block, on `paper`. Office 'Text 2'. 7.7:1 light, 8.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: slate-deep
tokens.usage: Section headings (I. PRESENTACIÓN, 5.1.- Demanda educativa) and the CONTENIDO list, on `paper`. 10.8:1 light, 11.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Frame accents in the header block and table borders where a coloured rule is wanted. Never body text below 12pt in dark.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Fill of every data-table header row (Concepto, 2024, 2025…). Always paired with `on-table-head`.

tokens.name: on-table-head
tokens.usage: Header-row labels on `table-head`. 13.8:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Header fill for text-heavy matrices (the Certificaciones progresivas table) and alternating bands. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines of the header block and table cell borders, 0.5pt. Dark value meets 3:1 on the dark paper.

tokens.name: rule-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary separators: the dotted leader in CONTENIDO, footnote rule. Decorative only.

tokens.name: folio
tokens.usage: The six-digit correlative folio stamped top right of every page (002057). Only for the folio. 8.6:1 light, 8.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Repository and dataset URLs cited in Fuente lines and references, underlined. 5.9:1 light, 8.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (the program's own figure). From the Estudio N°02 and header palette. Dark value kept mid-tone so it stays 3:1 apart in lightness from chart-2.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series, the contrasting comparison (region vs. national). Amber from Estudio N°02 and the tríptico.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series. Office accent blue used across the MTPE and BCRP charts.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series. Burnt orange from the tríptico indicator charts.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Other / remainder series and projected-year markers.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Cover title, 36pt Calibri Bold, uppercase, `slate`, up to three lines.

styles.name: cover-program
styles.usage: Program name under the cover title, 22pt Arial Bold, `slate`.

styles.name: cover-meta
styles.sample: Elaborado por: Programa Académico de Psicología
styles.usage: Cover date and authorship, 14pt Calibri Bold, `slate`.

styles.name: contents-title
styles.usage: The CONTENIDO page title, 26pt Calibri Light, `slate-deep`.

styles.name: contents-entry
styles.usage: One entry of CONTENIDO, 17pt Calibri Light, `slate-deep`.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Chapter heading with Roman numeral, 16pt Calibri Bold uppercase, `slate-deep`.

styles.name: subsection
styles.usage: Decimal subsection, 14pt Calibri Bold, sentence case, `slate-deep`.

styles.name: run-in
styles.usage: Third-level heading run into its paragraph, 12pt Calibri Bold, `ink`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Según la Encuesta Nacional de Hogares de 2022 del INEI, Piura cuenta con una población de 1,9 millones de habitantes.
styles.usage: Running text, 12pt Calibri on a 22pt line (1.5 spacing), justified, `ink`.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Tabla 9. Demanda de Psicólogos estimada para los años 2023 y 2024
styles.usage: Table and figure caption set ABOVE the table, 12pt Calibri, centered, `ink`.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: 1 Según Resolución del Consejo Directivo N° 105-2023-SUNEDU/CD

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Header row of data tables, 8pt Arial Bold, `on-table-head` on `table-head`.

styles.name: table-cell
styles.usage: Body cells, 8pt Arial Bold (the source bolds every cell), `ink`, figures right-aligned and tabular.

styles.name: source
styles.sample: Fuente: INEI 2017-2022. Encuesta Nacional de Hogares (ENAHO).
styles.usage: Fuente and projection notes directly under a table, 7pt Arial Bold Italic, `ink`, left-aligned to the table.

styles.name: header-title
styles.usage: Center column of the controlled-document header, 10pt Arial Bold uppercase, `slate`.

styles.name: header-meta
styles.usage: Fecha / Versión / Hoja labels and values, 9pt Arial Bold, `slate`; the page number itself is regular.

styles.name: folio
styles.usage: Correlative folio number, 16pt Helvetica/Arial, `folio`, top-right above the header.

tokens.name: space-cell
tokens.usage: Inner padding of table cells and header-block cells (3pt), and the gap between a caption and its table.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a table and its Fuente line; between cover meta lines.

tokens.name: space-line
tokens.usage: One body line (22pt). Paragraph spacing is one blank line; space above a heading is one line.

tokens.name: indent-1
tokens.usage: 1 cm. Indent of a section's body under its heading; the -Población… criteria list.

tokens.name: indent-2
tokens.usage: 1.5 cm. Indent of paragraphs under a run-in 6.2.1 heading.

tokens.name: page-inset
tokens.usage: The header block's left and right inset from the sheet edge (64pt).

tokens.name: margin-start
tokens.usage: Left text margin, 3 cm (85pt).

tokens.name: margin-end
tokens.usage: Right text margin, 2.4 cm (68pt).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: table cells, header block, cover panel. The system has no rounded corners.

border.note: Hairlines are the only structural line.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 0.5pt rule: header-block grid and table cell borders, in `rule`.

sheet.note: Page geometry of the A4 portrait report.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: A4 width, 210 mm (595pt).

tokens.name: sheet-height
tokens.usage: A4 height, 297 mm (842pt).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Text column width between margin-start and margin-end (about 75 characters of body).
